overview:
The **Battle of Tython (Great Galactic War)** (3660 BBY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Great Galactic War**, fought on or above **Tython**. Sith invasion force breaching je'daii temple mesas on tython with crimson saber fire reflecting off ancient stone arches.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Great Galactic War in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Battle of Tython (Great Galactic War) within the broader **Great Galactic War** campaign. Front-line reports describe sith invasion force breaching je'daii temple mesas on tython with crimson saber fire reflecting off ancient stone arches.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **3660 BBY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Great Galactic War.
significance: The Battle of Tython (Great Galactic War) illustrates how the Great Galactic War reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
